source_citation: Font, Swart, Bruss, Sheehan, Heywood and Queste (2024), Ventilation of the Arabian Sea Oxygen Minimum Zone by Persian Gulf Water, JGR Oceans 129, e2023JC020668.
source_locator: Section 4.1 opening paragraph, printed page 5 of 16; Figures 2 and 3 are cited by the authors, not digitized here.
source_review_mode: Manual review of primary published PDF text via web reader, including Sections 2 and 4.1 and the opening of Section 3. No local scientific PDF parsing, figure digitization, native profile reconstruction or claim of original PDF byte custody.
source_text_excerpts: corresponding to depths from 150 to 400 m
its core is located at a depth of 200 m
geographic_scope: Continental-slope PGW outflow offshore the northern coast of Oman; source study combines two across-shelf transects. No unique core station, endpoint contour, full-current footprint or geographical bottom is reconstructed.
temporal_scope: Published study synthesis of repeated glider transects during 2015-2016 and 2021-2022; separate locations, platforms and discontinuous deployments. These two reported depth descriptors are not assigned to an exact occupation, month, season or common annual mean.
core_definition: Property-defined PGW concentration/core within the hydrographic outflow. Source Section 4.1 explicitly distinguishes maximum PGW fraction from maximum velocity; not a maximum-speed core depth.
depth_band_definition: Author-reported regional depth extent corresponding to the stated potential-density population. Not paired upper/lower boundaries of one profile, an instantaneous thickness, annual extrema, confidence interval or velocity-zero footprint.
source_processing_context: Source observations were projected onto across-shelf transects and median-binned onto 2 m vertical and 1 km horizontal grids; source interpolation and smoothing remain part of the published analysis, not reconstructed by OSW.

Earlier Seaglider velocities are geostrophic estimates referenced to dive-average currents; the later SeaExplorer carries ADCP. Do not describe every deployment as direct ADCP or independent replication of the same section.
Source transport is tracer-weighted flow rate. It is not stored water volume, and no source transport value is used in these depth references.
license: Source article states Creative Commons Attribution License; authors and DOI retained. Only the two short numeric source excerpts are reproduced; original PDF not redistributed.
